sloka: तस्य ऋषेः परम उदारम् वचः श्रुत्वा नृप नरोत्तमौ ।स्नात्वा कृत उदकौ वीरौ जेपतुः परमम् जपम् ॥१-२३-३॥
transliteration: tasya ṛṣeḥ parama udāram vacaḥ śrutvā nṛpa narottamau ।snātvā kṛta udakau vīrau jepatuḥ paramam japam ॥1-23-3॥

translations.english: On hearing the very affectionate call of Viswamitra both the brave princes had their bath and offered oblations to Sungod (standing in the water) and recited the holy name of the Lord.
translations.hindi: बालकाण्ड सहाराज दशरथ ने प्रसन्न हो कर ओर पुत्रों .के माथे संघ कर उन्हें विश्वामित्र जी को सौंपा
